subject.title: Feature request: MEMORY.md size warning/limit enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw add core Control UI save-time MEMORY.md budget enforcement and an archive workflow, or fold the remaining behavior into the broader bounded-memory design?
rationale: Current main already provides diagnostics and prompt warnings, but the remaining request changes workspace-file editing and memory lifecycle behavior rather than repairing a single broken code path.

options.title: Define Narrow Control UI Guard
options.body: Add a Control UI budget meter and explicit save-time warning or block for bootstrap files, with a guided trim/split path and no automatic archive in the first pass.

options.title: Fold Into Bounded Memory
options.body: Track hard write limits and archive behavior under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42877 and use this issue only for the MEMORY.md UI case after that direction is approved.

options.title: Keep Diagnostics Only
options.body: Declare prompt, doctor, and `/context` diagnostics sufficient for now and close the UI/save-enforcement request only after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Define Narrow Control UI Guard
recommendation.body: Add a Control UI budget meter and explicit save-time warning or block for bootstrap files, with a guided trim/split path and no automatic archive in the first pass.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history across bootstrap truncation handling and the Agents dashboard/file editing surface.
